description: What needs a person right now, newest first: a keyword whose mentions spiked in the last hour (mention.spike), whose negative share of the last 24 hours jumped (sentiment.negative_spike), that turned noisy (keyword.noisy), a channel whose last sends all failed (channel.failing), a workspace feed that failed 3 reads in a row (feed.failing), a person with 100,000+ followers whose relevant mention nobody answered for 3 hours (mention.unanswered_influencer, one item per person about their newest such post), or many relevant posts on one keyword sharing an intent tag or a hashtag in 24 hours (mention.topic_cluster). Detected once an hour; items resolve on their own when the condition is gone. Open items by default; status "all" reads the history. Each item has a one-line title, the facts in data, and data.url pointing at the dashboard.

items.description:
- mention.spike: far more mentions in the last hour than usual.
- sentiment.negative_spike: the negative share of the last 24 hours jumped.
- keyword.noisy: most scored matches are noise.
- channel.failing: the channel's last sends all failed.
- feed.failing: a workspace feed failed its last 3 hourly reads.
- feed.recovered: it read again after failing.
- mention.unanswered_influencer: a top influencer's relevant mention is still open after 3 hours.
- mention.topic_cluster: posts on one keyword share a tag in 24 hours.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
